verdict.rationale: Missive documents rule-based automation ('Automate your workflows', 'Up to 1000 rules') and MCP/API integrations that could act across conversations, implying some capacity for bulk/automated actions, but there is no explicit evidence of a UI bulk-select-and-act feature (e.g., mass archive, mass label, mass reply) or documentation describing bulk operations as such. missing for 10: explicit bulk-select UI actions, documented bulk API endpoints for multi-item operations, and independent confirmation that rules/MCP can operate on many items simultaneously rather than one-by-one.
